about: The private state folder ~/.local/state/bowerloom of the main project. Its project folder id is the placeholder {{PROJECT_ID}}; a state folder is keyed to the real path of a project, so it fits a copy test or a read test, and not a project at a new path. Made by tools/fixtures-0.8/make.mjs from the published bowerloom@0.8.0-beta.1. Each key of "files" is a path with its mode and its text, or base64 when the bytes are not UTF-8. Paths hold the placeholders {{HOME}}, {{PROJECT}}, {{STATE}}, {{PROJECT_ID}}, and {{ROOT}} (the folder above HOME).
